q: Break that down by product and channel.

checks.what: tool: reuses prior scope (drilldown or same window)

answer:
This week (partial) the decline is concentrated in Instagram feed traffic and in a few top SKUs — key examples: Meow Scratch Lounge, Pawveralls Suspender Boots and WingBird Smart Flapping Toy earned most revenue last week from ig_feed but are much smaller this partial week on the same channel.

Evidence
- Top affected product × channel (last week → this week, revenue · orders)
  - Meow Scratch Lounge (ig_feed): ₹62,899 · 29 orders → not present on ig_feed this week (top ig_feed scratch-style sale this week is Play Scratch Lounge ₹18,553 · 8 orders).
  - Pawveralls Suspender Boots (ig_feed): ₹40,450 · 24 orders → ₹2,118 · 1 order (ig_feed) this week.
  - WingBird Smart Flapping Toy (ig_feed): ₹37,099 · 38 orders → ₹2,202 · 2 orders (ig_feed) this week.
- Ad spend and ROAS by channel (selected)
  - ig_feed: large ad spend on these SKUs last week (e.g. Pawveralls ig_feed ad spend ₹53,608 last week) fell sharply this week (ad spend for those SKUs on ig_feed mostly ≪ last week), matching the drop in revenue.
  - Google channels kept some high-ROAS pockets (examples: Pawveralls on google_pmax/ search show product net ROAS (allocated) >2 in both periods), so loss is concentrated in paid social rather than paid search.
- What this implies
  - Most of the week-to-week sales loss sits in ig_feed traffic for top SKUs; lower ig_feed ad spend and fewer orders on those SKUs together explain most of the change.

Period: 2026-10-05..2026-10-11 vs 2026-10-12..2026-10-14 (this week partial) · Currency: INR · Data as of 2026-10-14
